supersedes: button family in ponos_controls_v2; selector design retained unchanged

visual_rules.selector_mode: text-first inline tabs and content-width pill chip
visual_rules.button_shape: soft rectangle, not capsule or full pill

activity_kind_tabs.mode: scrollable on tiny widths if needed

activity_picker.label: persistent Activity label where used in form
activity_picker.expanded: anchored list or bottom sheet on narrow screen

duration.accessibility: plus and minus each at least 48dp hit region and announce value
duration.alternative: numeric entry in dialog on phones

buttons.primary: filled Aegean rectangle with 10dp corners, no shadow; one per visible decision scope
buttons.secondary: white, 1dp soft outline, 10dp corner radius; tinted hover; no shadow
buttons.ghost: text-first unboxed default; soft 10dp tinted hover/focus area
buttons.destructive: unboxed red label default; full danger confirmation inside modal only
buttons.icon: unboxed default, soft 10dp rounded-square hover/focus region

accessibility.text_scaling: up to 200%, wrapping or scroll compact tabs when needed

implementation_scope: Design only, preserve existing Ponos data flow and behavior until explicitly approved for Flutter handoff.
mock_data_policy: Use only Test as sample activity name; do not use real or prior Ponos activity names.
ui_state_contract: Selectors preserved from v2 except placeholder content; buttons use 10dp radius with at least 48dp interactive touch area.
